_meta.description: Maps BRPN shell × Natural Tool × Expression Layer to emotion category and processing order. Core of the Buoyancy Reflex NLP system.

happy.raw: A state of elevated subjective wellbeing arising from alignment between expectation and outcome.

love.raw: Deep relational resonance. Persistent attachment pattern with high envelope containment.

inspiring.raw: Upward-directional emotional transmission. Elevates buoyancy in recipient.

determined.raw: Sustained directive force toward a defined outcome. Hammer-dominant signature.

spiritual.raw: Non-material grounding resonance. Access beyond direct sensory sequence patterns.

guiding.raw: Directional transmission without force imposition. Stick-led orientation sequence.

angry.raw: High-velocity force without directional containment. Hammer firing without Maze anchor.

hateful.raw: Persistent Knife-Scissors loop with negative valence. Divides and isolates with intent.

forgiving.raw: Dissolution of prior Knife-divide. Envelope re-engagement following rupture.

condescending.raw: Elevated Knife positioning over recipient. Asymmetric precision assertion.

disrespectful.raw: Scissors-dominant dual-action targeting the containment boundary of recipient.

neutral.raw: Zero-delta buoyancy state. No directional force. Pure observational processing.

sad.raw: Downward buoyancy shift. Envelope partially collapsed. Stick velocity reduced.

worried.raw: Puzzle cycling without resolution. Anticipatory Knife-divide of future state.

jealous.raw: Puzzle comparison with inverted Hammer — force directed inward rather than outward.

lucrative.raw: High-value Knife-division yielding asymmetric positive outcome. Aerospace-shell gain signal.

concerned.raw: Envelope monitoring external risk. Maze-anchored with Puzzle sub-loop active.

judgemental.raw: Knife operating at maximum precision without Scissors refinement. Fixed division without duality awareness.

expression_layers.description: Core expressions that must be identified BEFORE emotion can be confirmed. These are the prerequisite expression states.

1.name: Contextual Statements
1.description: Direct declarative communication. Subject makes a statement about a known state. Requires Maze anchor to proceed.

2.name: Questions
2.description: Interrogative seeking — the subject is orienting toward unknown territory. Puzzle must activate before emotion resolves.

3.name: Expression / Exclamation
3.description: High-force emotional output. Hammer fires before Maze anchors. Emotion arrives before context is fully established.

4.name: Overall Sigmatic Expression of Sequence Patterns
4.description: Full multi-tool processing across session history. The accumulated sigma pattern determines emotion — no single sentence sufficient. Requires Scissors at final stage.

routing_table.description: Primary lookup: given shell + dominant tool → expression layer + likely emotion set

max_combinations.description: Maximum emotional expression combinations from 7 tools × 3 buoyancy types (foundation/reflexive/performance)

FOUNDATION.description: Base grounding state — most stable buoyancy, Maze-dominant

max_combinations.note: Each tool can fire in any of 3 buoyancy states = 7×3=21 unique emotional resolution paths. Full sequence across all 7 tools = 128 ordered combination possibilities.

redundant_system.description: Buoyancy shell + LEATR can be applied independently to the Sentience Journal as a redundant verification layer

components.name: Sentience Journal
components.role: Internal session emotion tracking and sigma optimization
